reviewKind: Personal complete paired-text reading, cumulative-route rereading, chapter/omission comparison and selected primary-text checks; root also authored six restored units.

readScope.method: Read original97 paired screens in order, then every new source-checked paired addition and every changed final pair. Reread all Essential and Core paired routes; final Deep order preserves the read baseline with the inspected additions.

meaningJudgment.argument: The five parts connect automatic judgment to statistical checks, expertise/forecasting, reference-dependent choice and experience versus memory. The text retains experiments, numerical alternatives, author procedures and limits rather than only effect names.
meaningJudgment.shorterRoutes: Essential is independently readable, defines the modes before substitution, shows sampling/anchor/base-rate/regression cases, and includes the pain-profile evidence before the final two-selves discussion. Core adds cognitive ease, real expertise/forecasting cases, procedures, optimism, endowment, risk-policy conditions and sunk costs.
meaningJudgment.depthDecision: Accepted because the central five-part argument is sustained through cases, qualifications, counterarguments and real procedures. The screen/word totals describe the result; they are not acceptance quotas or a template for every nonfiction book.

closedFindings.change: Restored cognitive ease, public risk/affect, causal base rates, optimism/enterprise, mental accounts/sunk costs, and separate/joint evaluation in connected original RU/EN prose.
